title: Cerebus Apr #133 Aardvark-Vanaheim Dave Sim Jaka's Story 20
descriptionText: This is a rare and collectible Cerebus comic book from Aardvark-Vanaheim, featuring the story of Jaka's Story, Part 20. The issue number 133 was published in 1990, during the Copper Age of comics. The comic book is a single issue format, written and illustrated by Dave Sim, Gerhard, and Jeff Nicholson. The character of Cerebus, a dog-like creature, is featured in this US Comics tradition comic book. The comic book is in excellent condition, making it a great addition to any collector's comic book collection.
